compute.hardware: 2 x RTX 5090 (GPUs 2, 3; one process per GPU)

disposition.claim: independent axes add value over tied axes
disposition.rule: on grid, for 'independent axes add value over tied axes': supported iff J - J_diag, J - J_monotone and J - H* are each supported (mean >= 0.02 with lower bound > 0); not_supported_by_this_experiment iff at least one of the three has upper bound < 0.02; otherwise readiness_or_precision_insufficient; any failed guard -> readiness_or_precision_insufficient. The same rule on J_dec is reported DESCRIPTIVE

unsupported.TAWM/VLWM diagonal, monotone and anti-di: the #78 ports are continuous-only (ContinuousDynamics, horizon conditioning only): no description axis alpha
unsupported.TAWM/VLWM wrong-anchor control: their carrier is the #71 parser's; the fit-split wrong-anchor pool exists only as E99 carriers
unsupported.VLWM-adaptive: #78 trained a horizon controller for TAWM only (its adaptive evaluation arm); no VLWM controller exists
